params.name: start_timestamp
params.description: The start of the time range for audit logs (ISO 8601 format).

params.name: end_timestamp
params.description: The end of the time range for audit logs (ISO 8601 format).

params.name: entity_id
params.description: The ID of the entity to filter logs.

params.name: entity_type
params.description: The type/category of the entity to filter logs.

params.name: entity_name
params.description: The name of the entity affected by the action.

params.name: username
params.description: The username of the user performing the action.

params.name: ip
params.description: The IP address of the client device that initiated the action.

params.name: event_source
params.description: The source of the event to filter logs.

params.name: next_token
params.description: Token for fetching logs of the next page.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of audit log events for the given workspace.
